sources.title: API changelog
sources.evidence: March 2025 search-mode update includes Reasoning Pro; April 2025 adds Sonar image uploads. November 2025 automated web_search/fetch_url_content announcement specifically concerns Sonar Pro, not Reasoning Pro. December 15, 2025 retirement concerns sonar-reasoning without Pro.

sources.title: Migrate from Sonar — overview
sources.evidence: Sonar Chat Completions support ended September 27, 2026. Synchronous/streaming compatibility requests are gradually reformulated as Agent API requests; this does not prove continued use of the original Reasoning Pro backend.

sources.title: Perplexity API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: January 23, 2026 terms cover Sonar API services. Sections 2.1 and 3.1 grant restricted service use and reserve service/model IP to Perplexity or licensors; support proprietary hosted-service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Media & Attachments — legacy Sonar API
sources.evidence: Legacy API guide documents image input alongside text and text responses. Code examples use sonar-pro; this guide alone cannot establish exact Reasoning Pro support. Read with the exact model card image-input caveat.

sources.title: Accelerating Sonar Through Speculation

sources.title: Sonar Reasoning Pro provider endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Distributor metadata describes the exact model as powered by DeepSeek R1, with text/image input, text output and 128000 context. Its tool-choice flags conflict with absence of tools in supported parameters and are not treated as proof.

name.note: Exact public model name and API identifier sonar-reasoning-pro.

developer.note: Perplexity publishes and supplies this named API model.

family.note: Normalize to the documented Sonar range; reasoning is a capability subgroup.

release_date.note: Clear unsupported 2024-01-01. January 28 is an unverified third-party claim; a February 3 post reproduces an already-listed model; March 7 is OpenRouter listing and March 19 is a developer update. Searches for the original Perplexity/CEO announcement did not recover an exact-variant launch post. Neither first day nor month is securely established.

open_weights.note: This record describes Perplexity's proprietary hosted Sonar service, not a downloadable checkpoint. An upstream open-weight model would not make the service itself open weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under Perplexity API terms. No MIT license is inherited from an asserted R1 ancestor.

parameters_b.note: Reviewed exact documentation and later first-party communication, deployment, RL and speculative-decoding research. None binds a parameter count or identified R1 checkpoint to this exact model; distributor ancestry alone cannot justify 671B. Complete hosted-system size is also undisclosed.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model activated count found. The research article's 37B figure describes DeepSeek-V3/R1, without establishing that specific backbone for Sonar Reasoning Pro.

architecture.note: No exact-model topology disclosed in the reviewed first-party material. Do not transfer R1 MoE/MLA, ordinary Sonar's Llama backbone, or a later Agent API backend.

context_window.note: Last documented 128K; distributor corroborates decimal 128000. Earlier reproduced docs show 127K. Retain the later legacy limit, without asserting current backend behavior.

modalities.note: Retain documented API-level text/image input and text output. Exact card specifically restricts image input combined with structured outputs, consistent with the legacy media guide and distributor metadata. Does not establish a natively multimodal backbone or image generation.

reasoning.note: Explicit Chain-of-Thought capability; exact response example includes a thinking section.

tool_call.note: Clear blanket false. Retrieval and citations are established, but reviewed exact-model evidence does not establish model-selected tool invocation or custom function calling. November Pro Search tool orchestration is explicitly Sonar Pro; it is not borrowed. Conflicting distributor tool flags do not resolve the issue.

description.note: Describes the historical model and established behavior without transferring current Agent API capabilities.

patch.notes: Original release timing remains unresolved: the 2024-01-01 catalog date is unsupported; January 28, 2025 is a third-party claim, February 3 documentation screenshots show earlier availability than the March 7 OpenRouter listing, and March 19 was an update. The 128K context and image-input restrictions describe the legacy service. Sonar Chat Completions support ended September 27, 2026; compatibility requests are gradually reformulated through Agent API, so successful requests do not verify the original backend. OpenRouter describes Reasoning Pro as DeepSeek R1-powered, but reviewed first-party model, training, deployment and speculative-decoding sources do not bind an exact backbone or parameter count to this model. Tool invocation remains unverified; built-in retrieval alone does not establish model-selected tools, and Sonar Pro's Pro Search capabilities are not inherited.

summary: Audited all fourteen fields. Normalized Sonar family, classified the hosted license, removed unsupported 2024 release and blanket no-tools assertion, and clarified the historical description. Confirmed legacy context, reasoning and API modalities. Parameters and exact topology remain undisclosed after later first-party research review; original release timing and model-selected tool support remain unresolved. No sibling or migrated Agent API specifications were transferred.
